notes: Shinjuku (Toei Oedo E27) station catalog for the GTEki kit: stair nosing, escalator comb plates and newels, and single-aisle gate rows, one entry per distinct parameter set. Generated by stations/shinjuku/tools/kit-catalog.ts from the scene layout; do not hand-edit, regenerate. All dimensions are the scene's drawn values (heights are symbolic, not surveyed): dimension_basis is synthetic. Stair nosing and escalator comb and newel dressings use 128 x 128 AO (ao_res 128) to keep the mobile kit texture total near 3.1 MB (8.9 MB at full size, budget 8 MB). 43 of 45 stair and escalator runs are covered; 2 stay as placeholders (outside the kit ranges).
